; LanguageSettings replaces the legacy Settings language properties in 3.29.
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/localization/qml/LanguageSelector.qml
    TRAVERSE ListView#root
        REPLACE model WITH {
            model: languageSettings.availableLanguageCodes.concat(["zh_CN"])
        }
        TRAVERSE ArkControls.SelectableItem
            REPLACE text WITH {
                text: modelData === "zh_CN" ? "简体中文" : root.languageSettings.getLanguageDisplayName(modelData)
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/settings/LanguageAndKeyboard.qml
    TRAVERSE Background#root
        TRAVERSE ColumnLayout#column
            TRAVERSE ArkControls.Cell#languages
                TRAVERSE ArkControls.CellItem[.objectName~SystemLanguage]
                    REPLACE status WITH {
                        status: languageSettings.languageCode === "zh_CN" ? "简体中文" : root.languageSettings.getLanguageDisplayName(languageSettings.languageCode)
                    }
                END TRAVERSE
            END TRAVERSE
        END TRAVERSE
        TRAVERSE Component#languageDialog
            TRAVERSE SelectionComponent
                REPLACE model WITH {
                    model: languageSettings.availableLanguageCodes.concat(["zh_CN"])
                }
                REPLACE display WITH {
                    display: (modelData) => { return modelData === "zh_CN" ? "简体中文" : root.languageSettings.getLanguageDisplayName(modelData); }
                }
            END TRAVERSE
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
